what_happened: The job to let `athena retry` re-verify a stale job's kept candidate on the new tip was rejected at the final verdict. One of 9 acceptance criteria was unmet: the criterion that a new decision be appended at the end of docs/decisions.md, reversing the left-out alternative (d) of D10, giving the reason and citing D10, with no existing line changed. The one major finding says why: D157 was inserted in the middle of D156's last bullet instead of at the end of the log, so D156's closing sentence now reads as part of D157 (docs/decisions.md:4310-4353). No checks failed and there was no blocker. This is the follow-up to the earlier attempt 20261106-041052-wzy7, which failed because its criterion asked to edit an old line.
cause: The decision log is edited as free text. Athena has no code check that a new entry sits after the last existing entry, and none that the entries before it are byte-for-byte unchanged. The existing decisions check only looks for amend or confirm links, so a misplaced entry passes every check and only the verifier, reading the diff at the end, notices it. The producer is also not told where or how to append, and the file is long enough (over 4000 lines) that the end is easy to miss. The same missing structural check let the previous attempt's impossible 'annotate line 297' criterion through.
prevention: Add a check in the decisions test and in the producer's local checks. It compares docs/decisions.md with its base version and fails unless the base is an exact byte prefix of the new file, so every change is added text after the last old line. It must also confirm that each new entry starts with a well-formed decision id one greater than the previous highest. The check should run on the producer's own check run, so a misplaced entry fails before the final verdict. The failure message should say 'append at end of file'.
proposed_request: Re-do job 20261106-062207-cbcc. Let `athena retry` re-verify a stale job's kept candidate on the new tip, and record the decision correctly. Outcome: (1) the behavior from the earlier attempt works as the request originally stated. Keep what that attempt achieved and change only the decision entry. (2) docs/decisions.md ends with a new decision, appended after the last line of the file and after D156's final bullet. It says it reverses the left-out alternative (d), 'Automatic re-verification on the new base', of the landing decision D10. It gives the reason that stale landings now recur with parallel jobs, and it cites D10 by id. No existing line of docs/decisions.md is changed, so D156 stays intact. (3) A test fails if the base version of docs/decisions.md is not an exact prefix of the new version, and the test passes on this change. (4) The existing checks pass: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets and cargo test.
